title: CW-VAE: Shape Generation via Conformal Welding Priors in Variational Autoencoders
venue: Mathematics, Computation and Geometry of Data
excerpt: This paper presents CW-VAE (Conformal Welding Variational Autoencoder), a framework using conformal welding as a geometric prior for 2D simply-connected shapes.
citation: Chenran Lin, Oscar Y.L. Chau and Lok Ming Lui (2025). "CW-VAE: Shape Generation via Conformal Welding Priors in Variational Autoencoders" Mathematics, Computation and Geometry of Data. 4(2).

title: How geometry of subduction zones correlates with earthquake dynamics
excerpt: Combines differential surface geometry and global seismic data to show that flatter subduction zones generate rarer, larger earthquakes while variable curvature zones produce frequent, smaller events.
citation: Oscar Y. L. Chau, Rebecca Bendick, Gary P. T. Choi, L. Mahadevan. (2026). "How geometry of subduction zones correlates with earthquake dynamics" ArXiv Preprint.
